title: SiteShrimp Photo Entry — Buildability Score variant
description: BCA Buildable Design Score (B-Score) site-observation variant per Code of Practice on Buildability, 1 May 2022 edition. Captures structural / wall / DfMA evidence visible in a photo so the project's B-Score calculator (Manpower Allocation × Point Allocation per Block × Min B-Score per project category) has documented site evidence. Severity is reinterpreted as buildability impact: Critical = below MIN B-SCORE gate for project category, Major = significant labour penalty or wet-trade where prefab specified, Minor = inefficient detail or coordination clash, Observation = informational. Sources: BCA COP on Buildability (1 May 2022 ed.), Buildable Design Score Calculator BS-01 BIP.
x-csv-header-convention: Each property maps 1:1 to a column in the Entries sheet. The 'x-csv-header' field is the exact column header string. Variant columns are appended after the base columns when the project's workCategory is 'Buildability Score'.

project_category.description: BCA COP 2022 Manpower Allocation table — verbatim project-category names. Drives which weightage column applies in the Point Allocation matrix. PPVC scores 35 pts for Private Residential (Non-Landed) but 45 for Public Residential, 50 for MRT/Industrial, and 35 for Commercial / School / Institutional / Others. Ideally captured at project level (single value per project), not per-photo — surfaced here so the AI can preserve it on every photo until a project-level field exists.

structural_system.description: BCA COP 2022 Buildable Design Score Point Allocation — Section A. Verbatim system names from the BS-01 BIP point matrix. The point allocation for each system varies by project category (Residential / Industrial / Commercial / Institutional / MRT) per the COP 2022 Point Allocation sheet.

enum: Prefabricated and prefinished wall with MEP services
Curtain wall / Full height glass partition
wall_system.description: BCA COP 2022 Section B Architectural System (Wall) — verbatim system names from the BS-01 BIP point matrix. Each system has a distinct point band per project category. Drywall partition for party-wall vs other-area distinction (4.1a vs 4.1b in the matrix) is tender-document level and not enforced here; the assessor records whichever the design specifies.

enum: Prefabricated MEP modules integrated with structural
mep_system.description: BCA COP 2022 Section C MEP System — verbatim names from the BS-01 BIP point matrix. Captures the M&E productivity component of the Buildable Design Score (chilled water, sprinkler, water pipes, MEP modules, etc.).

prefab_evidence.description: Set true when off-site / modular construction is visibly evident in the photo — lifting hooks, shear keys, joint grouting, factory-finished surfaces, gantry / crane lift in progress. Used to validate the structural_system / wall_system claim against site reality.

dfma_indicator.description: Design for Manufacturing and Assembly classification visible in the photo. Volumetric = whole rooms / pods (e.g. PPVC). Panellised = flat-pack walls / floors / facades. Hybrid = mix of prefab and cast-in-situ. Mostly cast-in-situ = traditional wet-trade. Used as an at-a-glance flag for site B-Score reviewers.

buildability_concern.description: Free-text observation of a buildability issue — wet trade where prefab specified, missed DfMA opportunity, coordination clash undermining prefab labour saving (e.g. 'wet plastering visible on ALC panel — defeats prefab labour saving', 'cast-in-situ wall on a project that should be PPVC per B-Score gate'). Optional; only emit when a real concern is visible.
